entry.name: Name
instructions.protection: CryptPass protects the vault using a master password and a separate recovery sequence. Keep both safe; losing either may prevent access to your vault.
instructions.local: Vault files are encrypted and stored in a location you choose. Cloud synchronization is provided by your own storage service, not by CryptPass.
instructions.legacy: Older vaults remain readable. The first successful save rewrites the vault using the authenticated format supported by the current CryptPass library.
